	# Read values
	TagData = system.tag.readBlocking([
	    source_No, source_Name, source_SKU, source_OEE, source_P, source_A, source_Q,
	    SKU1_OEE, SKU2_OEE, SKU3_OEE, SKU4_OEE, SKU5_OEE
	])
	ActiveRecipe, Name, SKU, OEE, P, A, Q, SKU1, SKU2, SKU3, SKU4, SKU5 = [data.value for data in TagData]
	
	# get boolean data (Tag Change script context)
	newValue = currentValue.value
	oldValue = previousValue.value
	
	# if tag value didn't change, do nothing
	if newValue == oldValue:
	    return
	
	# if OEE has no value, do nothing
	if OEE in (0, None):
	    return
	
	# if active recipe is equal to 50 or 0, do nothing
	if newValue in (50, 0, None):
	    return
	
	# Check if SKU1 is Empty
	if SKU1 in (0, None):
	    system.tag.writeBlocking(
	        [SKU1_Name, SKU1_SKU, SKU1_OEE, SKU1_P, SKU1_A, SKU1_Q],
	        [Name,      SKU,      OEE,      P,      A,      Q]
	    )

	elif SKU2 in (0, None):
	    system.tag.writeBlocking(
	        [SKU2_Name, SKU2_SKU, SKU2_OEE, SKU2_P, SKU2_A, SKU2_Q],
	        [Name,      SKU,      OEE,      P,      A,      Q]
	    )
	    return

# Source paths
    Path = "[default]BACC_VCL6/misc/protocol/TotalTime_ProtocolMem"
    StartTag = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/protocol/Start_TimeStamp"
    EndTag = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/protocol/End_TimeStamp"
   
    
	# Read data
    TagData = system.tag.readBlocking([Path, StartTag])
    Target, StartTime = [data.value for data in TagData]
    
    # Get Tag Value for "Monitor_unit2"
    newValue = currentValue.value
    oldValue = previousValue.value
    
    # only write if OEE has a value and tag event occured
    if  newValue == 50 and oldValue != 50:
        
        Start_timestamp = system.date.now()
        system.tag.writeBlocking(StartTag, Start_timestamp)
        
    elif newValue != 50 and oldValue == 50:
        
		End_timestamp = system.date.now()		
		system.tag.writeBlocking(EndTag, End_timestamp)	
        
		NewTime = system.date.secondsBetween(StartTime, End_timestamp)		
		T = NewTime + Target
		
		system.tag.writeBlocking(Path, T)

	EndTag = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Unit2 Starved/End_TimeStamp"

	TagData = system.tag.readBlocking([TimeStarved, StartTag])
	Starved = TagData[0].value
	StartTime = TagData[1].value
	
	# Get Tag Value for "Monitor_unit2"
	newValue = currentValue.value
	oldValue = previousValue.value
	
	# Trigger 0 - 1
	if oldValue == 0 and newValue == 1:
		Start_timestamp = system.date.now()
		system.tag.writeBlocking(StartTag, Start_timestamp)
	
	# trigger 1 - 0
	elif oldValue == 1 and newValue == 0:
		End_timestamp = system.date.now()
		
		system.tag.writeBlocking(EndTag, End_timestamp)
		
		NewTime = system.date.secondsBetween(StartTime, End_timestamp)
		
		TotalTime = NewTime + Starved # convert to minutes 		
		
		system.tag.writeBlocking(TimeStarved, TotalTime)

	# get boolean data (Tag Change script context)
	newValue = currentValue.value
	oldValue = previousValue.value
	
	# if tag value didn't change, do nothing

	# if OEE has no value, do nothing

	        [Name,      SKU,      OEE,      P,      A,      Q]
	    )
	    return

	    system.tag.writeBlocking(
	        [SKU3_Name, SKU3_SKU, SKU3_OEE, SKU3_P, SKU3_A, SKU3_Q],
	        [Name,      SKU,      OEE,      P,      A,      Q]

	        [SKU4_Name, SKU4_SKU, SKU4_OEE, SKU4_P, SKU4_A, SKU4_Q],
	        [Name,      SKU,      OEE,      P,      A,      Q]
	    )
	    return
	
	# Check if SKU5 is Empty
	elif SKU5 in (0, None):
	    system.tag.writeBlocking(
	        [SKU5_Name, SKU5_SKU, SKU5_OEE, SKU5_P, SKU5_A, SKU5_Q],
	        [Name,      SKU,      OEE,      P,      A,      Q]
	    )
	    return

# Clear Mem tag at shift change (Performance stats zeroed)
	TimeMemTag = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Unit 2 Stopping Mode/TotalTimeStopping_MemTag"
	StationsCount = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Unit 2 Stopping Mode/StationStoppingTotal.value"
	
	system.tag.writeBlocking(TimeMemTag, 0)
	system.tag.writeBlocking(StationsCount, 0)

# Tag Paths
	StatusCurrentStations = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Unit 2 Stopping Mode/Current_StationsStopping"
	TotalStationCount = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Unit 2 Stopping Mode/StationStoppingTotal"
	
	
	# Read entire array Data
	Read_TotalStationData = system.tag.readBlocking([TotalStationCount])[0].value
	Read_StatusCurrentStations = system.tag.readBlocking([StatusCurrentStations])[0].value
	
	# Only add the last station still in stopping
	if Read_StatusCurrentStations[0] and sum(Read_StatusCurrentStations) ==1: # EM03
		Read_TotalStationData[0] = Read_TotalStationData[0] + 1
	
	if Read_StatusCurrentStations[1] and sum(Read_StatusCurrentStations) ==1: # EM04
		Read_TotalStationData[1] = Read_TotalStationData[1] + 1
	
	if Read_StatusCurrentStations[2] and sum(Read_StatusCurrentStations) ==1: # EM05
		Read_TotalStationData[2] = Read_TotalStationData[2] + 1
	
	if Read_StatusCurrentStations[3] and sum(Read_StatusCurrentStations) ==1: # EM10
		Read_TotalStationData[3] = Read_TotalStationData[3] + 1
	
	if Read_StatusCurrentStations[4] and sum(Read_StatusCurrentStations) ==1: # EM11
		Read_TotalStationData[4] = Read_TotalStationData[4] + 1
	
	if Read_StatusCurrentStations[5] and sum(Read_StatusCurrentStations) ==1: # EM15
		Read_TotalStationData[5] = Read_TotalStationData[5] + 1
	
	if Read_StatusCurrentStations[6] and sum(Read_StatusCurrentStations) ==1: # EM16
		Read_TotalStationData[6] = Read_TotalStationData[6] + 1

		Read_TotalStationData[7] = Read_TotalStationData[7] + 1

		Read_TotalStationData[8] = Read_TotalStationData[8] + 1

		Read_TotalStationData[11] = Read_TotalStationData[11] + 1

		Read_TotalStationData[25] = Read_TotalStationData[25] + 1
	
	
	# Write entire array data
	system.tag.writeBlocking([TotalStationCount], [Read_TotalStationData])

#tag Paths
	StationStoppingDint = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Unit 2 Stopping Mode/StationStoppingDint"
	CurrentStations = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Unit 2 Stopping Mode/Current_StationsStopping"

	# Read PLC data
	ReadData = system.tag.readBlocking([StationStoppingDint])
	Dint = ReadData[0].value

	# Translate PLC dint to an array of bools
	Bits = [(Dint >> i) & 1 for i in range(32)]
	system.tag.writeBlocking([CurrentStations], [Bits])

	# Read Boolean values
	#DataIn = system.tag.readBlocking([CurrentStations])

	#StationsStopping = DataIn[0].value

# Tag Pathways
	Production_Started = "[default]BACC_VCL6/Status/Production_sequence"	
	TimeMemTag = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Unit 2 Stopping Mode/TotalTimeStopping_MemTag"
	StartTag = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Unit 2 Stopping Mode/Start_TimeStamp"
	EndTag = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Unit 2 Stopping Mode/End_TimeStamp"
	
# Get Tag Values
	TagData = system.tag.readBlocking([Production_Started, TimeMemTag, StartTag])
	MachineStart = TagData[0].value
	PreviousTime = TagData[1].value
	StartTime = TagData[2].value
	
# Get Tag Value for "Monitor_unit2"
	newValue = currentValue.value
	oldValue = previousValue.value
	
# Trigger 0 - 1
	if oldValue == 0 and newValue == 1 and MachineStart == 10:
		Start_timestamp = system.date.now()
		system.tag.writeBlocking(StartTag, Start_timestamp)
	
# trigger 1 - 0
	elif oldValue == 1 and newValue == 0 and MachineStart == 10:
		End_timestamp = system.date.now()
		system.tag.writeBlocking(EndTag, End_timestamp)
		
# Difference between Start and End. 
# Couldn't use Start_Timestamp becuase it must clear when Monitor_Unit2 changes state
		NewTime = system.date.secondsBetween(StartTime, End_timestamp)
		TotalTime = NewTime + PreviousTime 		 
		system.tag.writeBlocking(TimeMemTag, TotalTime)

	#  system.tag.writeBlocking(["[default]TagEvents/HighTimestamp"], [timestamp])

# Determine the station that takes the longest to stop

	#if oldValue == 0 and newValue == 1 and EM03:

		system.tag.writeBlocking(Path, TotalTime)

# Tag Pathways
	Path = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Cleaning/TotalTime_ChangeOverMem"
	StartTag = "[default]BACC_VCL6/MISC/Cleaning/Start_TimeStamp"
